constraints: GitHub and Hugging Face free tiers only
repository-authored synthetic and non-sensitive aggregate evidence only
no WORM, Object Lock, guaranteed replication, provider SLA, or production RPO/RTO claim

decisions.observed: Pinned Apache fixture namespace, table, snapshot, schema-evolution, and partition-evolution workload passed on GitHub.
decisions.inference: Interoperability is promising but one implementation is not universal conformance.
decisions.external_gate: A production catalogue and durable object store are not available.
decisions.benefit: Open catalogue protocol over rebuildable Iceberg metadata.
decisions.risk_or_cost: Adds a service and operational failure domain.
decisions.python_3_14: PyIceberg 0.11.1 passed in the optional Python 3.14.6 hosted job.
decisions.rollback: Delete optional catalogue metadata and rebuild from governed Parquet and receipts.

decisions.observed: Table creation, nanosecond timestamps, defaults, and row-lineage symbols passed; multi-argument transforms and deletion-vector symbols were unavailable.
decisions.inference: Selective capability checks are required before any v3 use.
decisions.external_gate: No Atlas workload currently requires a v3-only feature.
decisions.benefit: Potential future precision and row-lineage features.
decisions.risk_or_cost: Partial client support and reduced interoperability.
decisions.python_3_14: Optional PyIceberg path passed on hosted Python 3.14.6.
decisions.rollback: Retain the v2-compatible specification and governed Parquet.

decisions.observed: A local single-client workload passed correctness, snapshot history, reattachment, and source fallback.
decisions.inference: Useful for DuckDB-native analysis, not qualified for shared production operation.
decisions.external_gate: Multi-client and durable-catalogue evidence is absent.
decisions.risk_or_cost: Younger ecosystem and single-client evidence only.
decisions.python_3_14: Core remains independent; the experiment uses the DuckDB extension.
decisions.rollback: Drop the disposable catalogue and query governed Parquet directly.

decisions.capability: Git and Hugging Face replication workflow
decisions.observed: Conflict, merge, rollback read, inventory, clean restore, public revision pinning, and all package digests passed.
decisions.inference: Suitable as an additional public synthetic evidence mirror, not authoritative Bronze storage.
decisions.external_gate: WORM, guaranteed independent replication, production RPO/RTO, and SLA remain unmet.
decisions.benefit: No-cost public reproducibility across the two available providers.
decisions.risk_or_cost: Both histories are mutable and free-tier availability is best effort.
decisions.python_3_14: Packaging and verification passed on Python 3.14; Git mechanics have no added Python dependency.
decisions.rollback: Remove the optional mirror reference; retain repository and authoritative per-object receipts.

decisions.capability: lakeFS or equivalent production object versioning
decisions.observed: Portable Git mechanics passed, but no qualifying durable object store, Object Lock, replication, or production recovery contract exists.
decisions.inference: The workflow semantics alone do not close the storage gate.
decisions.external_gate: A qualifying storage provider or independently administered durable replica is required.
decisions.benefit: Branch and merge semantics could improve governed batch promotion.
decisions.risk_or_cost: Additional service complexity without a free-tier durability foundation.
decisions.rollback: Keep immutable payload receipts authoritative and discard optional workflow metadata.

decisions.observed: Root reproducibility, inclusion proofs, tamper detection, ordering, duplicate, and absent-leaf controls passed without dependencies.
decisions.inference: An additive batch index can improve audit efficiency without replacing object identity.
decisions.benefit: Compact batch integrity verification over existing SHA-256 receipts.
decisions.risk_or_cost: Non-membership proofs are unsupported and roots must never replace per-object receipts.
decisions.rollback: Discard the batch root and verify objects directly from their receipts.

decisions.observed: deltalake 1.6.2 passed one update, delete, append, final-state oracle, and version-0 recovery on Python 3.14.
decisions.inference: Technical viability does not establish Atlas demand.
decisions.external_gate: Governed update, delete, multi-writer, or unmet-transaction demand is not evidenced.
decisions.benefit: Native row mutation and time travel with a Python 3.14 client.
decisions.risk_or_cost: Adds an optional format and dependency while duplicating current append-oriented capabilities.
decisions.python_3_14: deltalake 1.6.2 passed on local 3.14.5 and hosted 3.14.6.
decisions.rollback: Remove the isolated dependency and retain Iceberg-ready Parquet.

decisions.observed: Hudi 1.2.0 with Spark 3.5.6 passed the common update, delete, append, and final-state workload in 21.509633 seconds; historical recovery was not verified.
decisions.inference: The Java, Spark, Maven bundle, and separate Python 3.11 runtime are disproportionate without measured high-update demand.
decisions.external_gate: Governed high-update demand and historical recovery evidence are absent.
decisions.benefit: Mature update/delete table semantics for genuinely high-update workloads.
decisions.risk_or_cost: Highest dependency and operational footprint of the evaluated options.
decisions.python_3_14: The isolated Hudi workload required Python 3.11; core Python 3.14 remained unaffected.
decisions.rollback: Remove the isolated Spark/Hudi job and retain Iceberg-ready Parquet.

maintainer_gate.recommended_decision: Use the Hugging Face mirror for public synthetic evidence and consider additive Merkle manifests; continue bounded Iceberg, v3, and DuckLake experiments; do not adopt lakeFS, Delta, or Hudi until governed workload or durable-storage evidence changes.
